name: dsh-mobile-console
description: Mobile access for DeepSeek Harness: one settings panel that publishes the phone entry URLs and QR codes, sets the tunnel hostname up through the Cloudflare API or a guided cloudflared login, writes the authority into the platform trust fence, manages the cloudflared child process, lists devices that recently connected, and revokes every paired browser session.

scripts.check: node test/qr.test.mjs && node test/trusted-hosts.test.mjs && node test/cloudflare.test.mjs && node test/cloudflared.test.mjs && node test/client-load.test.mjs
